## 1. Scope and Framing of the Query

This report addresses the question "What datasets are used?" with respect to the study *Convolutional Neural Networks and a Transfer Learning Strategy to Classify Parkinson's Disease from Speech in Three Different Languages* by Vasquez-Correa and colleagues ([Vasquez-Correa et al., 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.04374)).
